findings.message: Exfiltration path: reads sensitive data (github), ingests untrusted content (github) and can send data out (github) with no human approval. A prompt injection in the untrusted content could leak the data.
findings.recommendation: Break the chain: split the agent, remove one leg, or require approval on every egress action.

findings.message: github runs @modelcontextprotocol/server-github without a pinned version, so a new upstream release runs automatically.
findings.recommendation: Pin an exact version (npm/PyPI) or image digest and update it through change control.
